title: The narrator speaks first, and Next Stop stops the voice
items: Starting The Glessner Household, the narrator reads the title and Background, then John Glessner speaks, even when the flight lands before the voices have loaded.
Next Stop, Previous Stop and End Jaunt stop the voice that is speaking.
Mattie Williamson now says her kitchen is through the wall beside her, its window in the great arch on Eighteenth Street; her voice is recorded again.
